scripts.build: pnpm run clean && parcel build src/index.html --no-source-maps --dist-dir dist --public-url ./ && node ./scripts/compress-brotli.mjs dist
scripts.format: prettier --write "**/*.{md,yml,yaml}" && biome check --write src/scripts scripts package.json
scripts.lint: prettier --check "**/*.{md,yml,yaml}" && biome check src/scripts scripts package.json
